title: Despite concerns, the Trump administration still sends pregnant migrant minors to south Texas
content: Several children have had to leave the state to receive medical care, including abortions, that is unavailable in Texas.

title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
content: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course.

title: ICE activity is surging ahead of midterms. So is voter turnout.
content: Across the country, there are reports of heightened ICE activity. Advocates worry about how close it is to midterms, but so far voter turnout is surging.

title: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
content: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.

title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
content: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
content: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
content: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.

title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
content: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

title: The two most interesting risks to Anthropic
content: Anthropic gave a 94-page list of risk factors in its S-1 this week. Two of them stood out.

title: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
content: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.
